name: Rohu
description: A freshwater carp common across Indian rivers and ponds, prized for its soft, flaky texture and mild flavour. Sold whole or cut into steaks.

name: Katla
description: A large-bodied freshwater fish with firm, fatty flesh, well suited to curries and slow-cooked preparations.

name: Hilsa
description: A seasonal river fish known for its rich, oily flesh and distinct flavour, traditionally cooked in mustard sauce.

name: Pomfret
description: A flat-bodied saltwater fish with delicate white flesh and few bones, popular for frying and grilling.
